slides.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original bespoke full-bleed 16:9 photographic background for a professional Korean road-operations project presentation called RoadOps. Generate one single image, wide 2048x1152 composition. A quiet two-lane road inspired by Jeju Island, South Korea, in gentle heavy rain and low mist. Dark basalt stone roadside wall, restrained deep green vegetation, realistic wet charcoal asphalt with modest reflections, correct Korean road markings, the road curves into mist in the RIGHT HALF of frame. No specific real location or documented disaster. Calm, precise editorial cinematography with natural textures, charcoal/steel-blue tones and tiny moss-green accents. Composition is essential: the LEFT 42 percent is intentionally very dark low-detail shadow and mist, visually continuous with the scene, suitable for overlaying white slide typography; the recognizable road and vanishing point occupy the right half. Refined, believable, not dramatic catastrophe or tourism postcard. Natural light, no glossy CGI, no HDR, no neon, no oversaturation. No cars, no people, no emergency workers, no buildings, no signage with lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no text. Do not add any graphic elements or typography. This is a conceptual scenario recreation, not evidence photography. Create from scratch, not using or imitating a news photograph.

slides.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: an original photographic scenario recreation for a RoadOps presentation about Jeju road inspection. Use the provided reference image ONLY for the approved calm rainy atmosphere, charcoal/steel-blue tones, muted greenery, wet asphalt, and Jeju-inspired basalt roadside wall. Recompose the scene completely around one adult road-maintenance inspector actively inspecting a roadside drain; this PERSON and their inspection action must be the clear focal point, not the landscape. Output a landscape 4:3 photograph. Medium-distance three-quarter side view, natural camera height. The inspector fills roughly 65 percent of image height, centered with head and boots fully visible. They wear an unbranded white safety helmet, navy waterproof rainwear, a restrained yellow-green reflective safety vest, work gloves and waterproof boots. They crouch at the protected road shoulder, looking closely at shallow water around a drainage grate while illuminating the grate with a small handheld inspection light. Natural believable posture, exactly two hands, realistic anatomy and correct equipment. Their face is turned toward the inspection, not posing for camera. No particular real person or agency. Keep the basalt wall and rainy road softly visible as secondary context. Soft overcast daylight, gentle rain, quiet concentration, realistic textures and subdued colors matching the reference. Sufficient local light on the worker to make the action readable. No large dark blank region for typography; slide text will be outside the photograph. No emergency rescue scene, no deep floodwater, no vehicles, no police or firefighter markings, no 119, no logos, no lettering, no watermark, no UI or infographic. This is a conceptual fictional road-inspection scene, not an actual incident or field deployment. Preserve the reference atmosphere, but make the human inspection action dominant.
